caption: Dijkstra from A on the worked example: one row per step, Done lists the finished nodes, and 3(B) means cost 3 through B. C falls from 4 via A to 3 via B in step 1, and D from 6 via B to 4 via C in step 2, so the direct A-C edge of cost 4 is never used; step 3 gives B=1, C=3, D=4.

spec.title: Dijkstra steps from A
spec.aria: Step table of Dijkstra from A: step 0 has B at 1 via A, C at 4 via A and D at infinity; step 1 finishes B and C becomes 3 via B; step 2 finishes C and D becomes 4 via C; step 3 finishes D, giving B=1, C=3, D=4.
